description: Waits (up to waitSeconds, default 20, max 25) for a background job started by a long tool that answered status:"running" (tia_connect, tia_start, tia_show_ui, tia_project_create/save/saveas/close/archive, tia_compile, tia_source_put, tia_download, tia_upload, tia_export_xml, tia_export_block, tia_block_compare, tia_crossrefs, tia_io_map, tia_spec_apply, tia_cax_export/import, tia_hmi_screen_export, tia_hmi_screens_import, tia_hmi_validate, tia_global_library_create/open/save, tia_library_mastercopy_create, tia_vci_status, tia_vci_export, tia_vci_import) and returns its FINAL result with job:{id,tool,state,durationMs} — including a gate handoff if the operation ended in one. While a job runs, every other serve-bound tool answers kind:"busy" (with details.jobId): call this instead of polling tia_status, and never repeat the original call. A lifecycle job that is still running may be starting or waiting for a trust dialog; running alone is not G1 evidence. Follow its conditional nextSteps, and ask a human to confirm G1 only if the dialog is visible on the serve host. Does not call serve. Class R.

jobId.description: jobId returned by the long tool (or by a busy error's details.jobId)

waitSeconds.description: how long this call may wait (default 20, max 25)

name: tia_job_status
title: TIA — long-operation status
